title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
key_facts: Bluesky announced the Attie expansion at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 on Thursday 15 Oct.
Attie first offered AI tools to build custom social feeds; now builds websites, quizzes, games, polls and other interactive experiences.
Creations live on the AT Protocol (ATProto).
Chief executive Toni Schneider: "social vibe coding or vibe coding for your community."
Users can bring their own AI model or use open-weight options; Attie suggests ideas from public profiles.
Bluesky has 47 million registered users, with declining engagement as some returned to X.
Private data support on ATProto is in alpha, planned by end of year.
quote_evidence: Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider shared the news of Attie's new capabilities during an interview at Disrupt
That network today has 47 million registered users, though it's seen a decline in engagement
why_it_matters_hint: Lets non-programmers build shared interactive tools inside a social network.
